parts.name: band_guoc_cao_vn
sources: A strap of plastic, 55 mm wide and 2 mm thick.
Three nails of steel at each end, 2 mm across and 12 mm long (by eye from the photos).

parts.name: pad_guoc_cao_vn
sources: The grip pad: rubber of 3 mm under the sole (Tuổi Trẻ News, 2023: a grip pad makes the clog non-slip); its thickness by eye.

parts.name: sole_guoc_cao_vn
sources: The sole: vông wood (Erythrina, a light wood of clogs, Vietnam Discovery), 70 mm at the heel and 14 mm at the ball, by eye from the photos.
